tablet.notes:
Searching on the conversation list: the searched word is yellow in each result, and opening one shows the conversation with every match highlighted.
In a word search the header shows the words, the arrows are chevrons, the bar slides in and the results slide into view one after another.
Since the last update: group chats show their unread state (with Message+ build 124 on the phone).
